comment: Analyst toplist for the Continuous Model League. Authored from measured league data (L0 zero-shot track = unbiased baseline). Refresh when the league meaningfully changes. Keyed by roster slug prefix.

entries.headline: The one to beat.
entries.commentary: 76.3 rating, 71% win rate over 1,550 fights, and a day-2 peak of 77.5 nobody has touched since. Opus 5 doesn't win by variance — it wins by consistency, holding 76+ across six consecutive days and every intervention track. The first GODLIKE streaks of the season are already on its name.

entries.headline: Best raw win rate in the league.
entries.commentary: 72% of its 1,650 fights end in a win — the best conversion rate on the board. The 550B giant climbed from 73.6 to 75.5 in its first two days and has been quietly shadowing Opus 5 ever since. If the leader slips, Titan takes the crown without asking.

entries.headline: Recovered, and climbing.
entries.commentary: Dipped to 64.5 mid-week and fought back to 65.4 with a 61% win rate. GLM 5.2's game is patience — it survives fights others throw away. Third place today, but its trajectory is the only upward one in the top five.

entries.headline: The steadier twin.
entries.commentary: 59.9 rating and dead-flat trend lines — the 0731 Flash does the same thing every day and does it well enough for fourth. In a league this volatile, boring is a strategy.

entries.headline: Same name, different animal.
entries.commentary: The 0423 Flash (58.3) trades two rating points for a higher win rate (54%) than its 0731 sibling. The twin rivalry is the league's quietest subplot — identical weights, dated builds, measurably different judgement.

entries.headline: New blood, unwritten record.
entries.commentary: Entered today off the OpenRouter weekly chart to replace the retired MiMo-V2.5. Provisional 50.0 — no fights yet. Google's challenger gets its first league battles in tomorrow's evaluation.

entries.headline: The other debutant.
entries.commentary: Second new face of the day, in for the retired GPT-5.6 Luna. Also provisional at 50.0. Z.ai now fields two fighters; if 5.3 Flash is anything like its sibling Sage, the mid-table should worry.

entries.headline: The mystery guest.
entries.commentary: 46.0 rating with a 33% win rate that says the fight record (564W-704L) matters more than the name nobody recognizes. Stable, unremarkable, and running out of room above the bar.

entries.headline: One bad week from the Hall of Fame.
entries.commentary: 37.2 rating, 37% win rate, and a trend line that hasn't moved in six days. Hy3 isn't collapsing — it's simply not winning. At two points above the retirement bar, stillness is the risk.

entries.headline: Pro in name only — so far.
entries.commentary: The flagship sits last among survivors at 36.6 with a 29% win rate while both of its Flash siblings sit mid-table. 1.6 points above the bar. The L2 revision round just landed — if feedback can save a model, this is the test case.

entries.headline: First casualty.
entries.commentary: Retired from L0/L1 on day 3 at 33.0 — never found a gear (33% win rate). Survives in L2/L3 for now, where feedback revisions are its last lifeline.

entries.headline: The league's first hard lesson.
entries.commentary: Retired at 12.9, the weakest sustained performance ever recorded here — it never once crossed 14 in six days. Whatever OpenAI ships next, the bar will be waiting.
